title: wc_AesGcmSetKey incompatibility: silent failure, not documented at error site
description: wc_AesGcmSetKey internally calls wc_AesEncrypt to pre-compute the GCM H-subkey, which requires aes->rounds to be set. When WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY intercepts wc_AesSetKey, it returns 0 immediately (skipping software key expansion), so aes->rounds stays 0. A subsequent wc_AesGcmSetKey call then calls wc_AesEncrypt and fails with KEYUSAGE_E. The failure surfaces only when the GCM operation runs, not at key setup time, and the error message does not point to this constraint. The header note says to use wc_AesSetKey instead, but every wolfSSL TLS example and most integration guides use wc_AesGcmSetKey for GCM. This will generate repeated user issues. Scenario: user integrates wolfSSL TLS with crypto2dev, copies a standard GCM setup snippet using wc_AesGcmSetKey, gets KEYUSAGE_E at the first encrypt, opens a support ticket. Maintenance consequence: repeated identical bug reports with no easy diagnostic path.
